description: This file defines a custom exception class 'EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException' used in the eShopOnWeb application. It handles cases where checkout is attempted with an empty basket.

classes.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating an attempt to checkout with an empty shopping basket.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException()
methods.description: Default constructor that sets a default message indicating the basket cannot be empty on checkout.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message and an inner exception.
